[EVENT] User is concerned about the maintenance of the Industrial Chic option.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Industrial Chic option requires:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Regular dusting with a soft, dry cloth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Avoiding hot or cold drinks directly on the wood surface.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Using a gentle wood cleaner for spills.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Reapplying wood polish or wax every 6-12 months.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Using a wood scratch remover for minor scratches.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested alternatives for lower maintenance:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - A wood table with a durable finish.
